title: Redis: scale-up a replica VM (RAM)
description: Vertically resizes a Redis replica VM. The IVmResizer powers off via vmrun, edits the .vmx (`memsize`), restarts, and verifies. Cluster-aware -- refuses primaries unless --force-primary. STUBBED in v0.6.0 (the full vmrun stop + .vmx edit + start sequence lands in 0.G.1.x).

observe.what: old/new table: ram (MB) 2048 -> 4096; outcome=ok; duration ~30-60s (graceful guest shutdown + restart)

whatProves: scale-up is cluster-aware (refused primary without --force-primary) and idempotent (re-running with same size = no-op). (Stubbed in v0.6.0; lands in 0.G.1.x.)
